formats.purpose: complete canonical typed dictionary snapshot used by CreateDictionary, LoadDictionary, and SaveDictionary
formats.import_effect: create a new dictionary or replace exactly one expected base revision with the complete entry set

formats.purpose: canonical typed bounded mutation set used only by LoadDictionary
formats.import_effect: apply explicit ordered UPSERT and DELETE records to exactly one expected base revision; unspecified entries remain unchanged

compatibility_operations.effect: create one new USER_DICTIONARY identity at revision one from a complete DB document or an explicitly empty DB document
DB performs complete expected-revision replacement; IMP performs only its explicit expected-revision UPSERT and DELETE records
serialize one authorized repeatable committed dictionary revision as canonical DB bytes without mutating it

document_envelope.payload_order: DB entries and IMP records are serialized in ordinal canonical entry_id order
document_envelope.content_digest: SHA-256 over canonical bytes with content_digest omitted

db_snapshot_entry_contract.value_rule: one spell.data.value/1 envelope whose canonical digest matches value_digest

imp_record_contract.delete_effect: commit one tombstone only when expected_entry_revision matches the live target
imp_record_contract.deterministic_order: ordinal canonical entry_id order; operation does not affect ordering

caller_binding.http_mutation: authenticated JWT subject and lowercase role plus bounded X-Spell-Session-Id and X-Spell-Client-Instance-Key-Id request-binding values
caller_binding.procedure_runtime: authorized service_principal_id plus execution_id, worker_generation, and deterministic_request_id
caller_binding.binding_rule: LoadDictionary and its idempotency settlement store and compare the exact selected caller binding; a procedure worker cannot fabricate or borrow a browser binding

source_provenance.original_bytes_rule: retain the exact bounded source bytes in non-executable quarantine storage through the configured audit retention period
source_provenance.normalization_rule: canonical parsing never overwrites, substitutes for, or changes the digest of the original bytes
source_provenance.audit_rule: the import settlement binds original and canonical digests, media type, actor, database receive time, dictionary identity, base revision, new revision, and outcome

import_transaction.atomicity_rule: all entries, the new dictionary revision, immutable source digest, and audit-outbox record commit in one transaction
import_transaction.precondition: base_revision must equal the authoritative current revision or explicitly identify creation revision zero
import_transaction.idempotency: same dictionary_id, base_revision, content_digest, exact caller binding, and idempotency key returns the original result
import_transaction.failure_rule: any diagnostic rejects the complete import and exposes no staged entry

export_snapshot.secret_redaction: authorization is evaluated before serialization; unauthorized values are omitted by rejecting the export rather than silently redacting it
export_snapshot.round_trip_rule: export then import into an empty authorized dictionary preserves entry identities, typed canonical values, and content digest

corruption_and_recovery.stored_digest_verification: verify dictionary, entry, and typed-value digests on every import/export boundary
corruption_and_recovery.restart_rule: discard uncommitted staging; never advance revision or emit audit-outbox evidence without the committed entries
corruption_and_recovery.retry_rule: retry requires the same immutable source digest or a new explicit import identity
corruption_and_recovery.backup_rule: exports are compatibility artifacts, not authoritative backups

forbidden_content: archive members, paths, symlinks, junctions, reparse points, devices, or alternate streams
include directives, external entities, templates, macros, expressions, or interpolation
Python pickle, marshal, eval, exec, import, callable, bytecode, or source
URL fetches, DNS, sockets, network, GCS, mission-network, spacecraft, or legacy-adapter references
credentials, access tokens, private keys, or implicit environment expansion
